# Face shaders and add-ons

Generated from the engine's own catalogs, the same text Card Studio's describe-a-finish reads. Field lines read `` `key` (type or range): what it does ``; "— leave out" marks fields a design written from a description shouldn't set (uploads, licensed assets, internal state). A host that has its own images may still set them (`decals`, `surfaceSources`, `logo.src`). Section names in quotes ("Lighting", "Fonts") refer to headings in these references.

## Face shaders

Up to 8 layers in `shaders`, applied in order. Each layer:
- `id` (built-in id | "custom"): Which shader.
- `side` ("front" | "back" | "both"): Which face(s).
- `target` ("skin" | "overlay"): skin: replaces the face colour under the metal lighting (a printed/anodised look); overlay: a layer blended over the face, can be view-dependent.
- `blend` ("normal" | "add" | "multiply" | "screen"): Overlay blend (default: the shader's own, else normal).
- `opacity` (0–1): Layer opacity; default 1.
- `params` ({ key: value }): Built-ins: param keys from the tables below. Custom: the annotated uniform names (e.g. uSpeed).
- `code` (WGSL string): id "custom" only (see "Custom shaders").
- `language` ("wgsl"): id "custom" only: always "wgsl" (the card engine runs WGSL; GLSL layers, absent or "glsl", are skipped).
- `animated` (boolean): false freezes an animated shader's clock.
- `time` (seconds) — leave out: Freezes the clock at this time. Leave out.
- `enabled` (boolean) — leave out: false keeps the layer but hides it. Leave out.

A layer's `opacity`, and `strength`-style params, scale its blend linearly: for a "faint" or "subtle" sheen use about 0.1–0.2, "clear" 0.3–0.5, full 1. The base metal should still dominate a faint layer: check the render.
Skins don't render on glass cards (use overlays there). Overlays with `blend: "screen"` or `"add"` brighten (sheens, glints, foil); `"multiply"` darkens; `"normal"` covers by alpha.

### Built-in shaders
- `thermal` Thermal contours (targets skin/overlay; default target skin; animated): Isotherm lines over a heat map that drifts and flows with the card's tilt, clearing the chip.
  - `contours` float 2–40, default 17 — Isotherm lines across the full heat range.
  - `speed` float 0–1, default 0.075 — Phase drift per second.
  - `phase` float 0–6.283, default 0.35
  - `flowStrength` float 0–3, default 1 — How far tilting the card pushes the heat.
  - `turbulence` float 0–3, default 1
  - `scale` float 0.3–3, default 1
  - `lineDarkness` float 0–1, default 0.3
  - `quiet` float 0–1, default 0.93 — Darkens the corner mark and name areas so branding reads.
  - `avoidChip` bool, default true
  - `ink` color, default "#121216"
  - `color1` color, default "#262b38"
  - `color2` color, default "#4d5969"
  - `color3` color, default "#879ca8"
  - `color4` color, default "#c9d9e0"
  - `color5` color, default "#fafcff"
- `liquid-metal` Liquid metal (targets overlay/skin; default target overlay; animated): Chrome that flows inside a mask (the artwork, the brand mark or a shape), stirred by tilt and pointer speed.
  - `mask` int options 0=Card artwork, 1=Brand mark, 2=Circle, 3=Daisy, 4=Diamond, 5=Metaballs, 6=Whole face, default 0 — Card artwork uses this face's artwork alpha.
  - `speed` float 0–20, default 1 — Clock multiplier (1 = a slow drift at rest).
  - `motion` bool, default true — Tilt, pointer speed and scrolling stir the metal.
  - `tint` color, default "#606060"
  - `repetition` float 1–10, default 3.03
  - `softness` float 0–1, default 1
  - `shiftRed` float -1–1, default -0.76
  - `shiftBlue` float -1–1, default -1
  - `distortion` float 0–1, default 0.57
  - `contour` float 0–1, default 0.12
  - `angle` float -360–360, default -194
  - `scale` float 0.2–4, default 1.1
  - `rotation` float 0–360, default 0
  - `offset` vec2 -1–1, default [-0.02,-0.025]
  - `avoidChip` bool, default true
- `caustics` Water caustics (targets skin/overlay; default target skin; animated): Rippling water over a tiled floor (or the card's artwork), refracting and focusing light; tilt stirs it.
  - `floor` int options 0=Tiles, 1=Card artwork, 2=Base colour, default 0
  - `speed` float 0–4, default 1
  - `waveHeight` float 0–6, default 1.6
  - `depth` float 0–1, default 0.3 — Refraction depth (card heights).
  - `scale` float 0.25–4, default 0.7
  - `tileScale` float 2–40, default 14
  - `caustics` float 0–1.5, default 0.3
  - `flowStrength` float 0–3, default 1
  - `deepColor` color, default "#057dd1"
  - `shallowColor` color, default "#0aa8eb"
  - `causticColor` color, default "#e9fbff"
- `lens` Coated lens (targets overlay/skin; default target overlay): A camera lens of coated glass whose rings, reflections and glint slide with the viewing angle.
  - `center` vec2 0–1, default [0.5,0.5] — Lens centre in face uv (0,0 bottom-left).
  - `radius` float 0.05–0.5, default 0.3 — In card heights.
  - `coating` color, default "#bababa" — Tints the ring coatings (grey = the original rose/violet).
  - `glint` float 0–3, default 1
  - `response` float 0–2, default 1
  - `exposure` float 0.2–4, default 1
- `vinyl` Vinyl record (targets skin/overlay; default target skin; animated): A spinning record with fine grooves, a paper label and an anisotropic sheen that follows the tilt.
  - `center` vec2 0–1, default [0.5,0.5]
  - `radius` float 0.1–0.8, default 0.46 — In card heights.
  - `grooves` float 20–400, default 140
  - `spin` float 0–78, default 33.3
  - `sheen` float 0–1.5, default 0.55
  - `labelSize` float 0.1–0.8, default 0.34 — Fraction of the record radius.
  - `vinylColor` color, default "#161718"
  - `labelColor` color, default "#d24a2c"
  - `bandColor` color, default "#efe2c6"
- `wood` Walnut veneer (targets skin/overlay; default target skin): Procedural wood: warped growth rings, figure and pore streaks along the grain.
  - `rings` float 2–60, default 16 — Growth rings per card height.
  - `figure` float 0–3, default 1 — How much the grain waves and swirls.
  - `pores` float 0–1, default 0.6
  - `scale` float 0.25–4, default 1
  - `angle` float -90–90, default 0
  - `seed` float 0–100, default 0
  - `lightColor` color, default "#a8774f"
  - `darkColor` color, default "#3f2416"
- `oil-slick` Oil slick (targets overlay/skin; default target overlay; default blend screen; animated): Thin-film interference: swirling iridescent bands whose colours shift with the viewing angle.
  - `strength` float 0–1, default 0.5
  - `thickness` float 0.2–5, default 1.6 — More thickness → more colour bands.
  - `scale` float 0.2–6, default 1.4
  - `speed` float 0–2, default 0.25
  - `hue` float 0–1, default 0
  - `saturation` float 0–1.5, default 0.85
- `gradient-mesh` Gradient mesh (targets skin/overlay; default target skin; animated): Four colours drifting and blending into a soft, warped mesh gradient with optional grain.
  - `colorA` color, default "#ff8a5b"
  - `colorB` color, default "#ffd166"
  - `colorC` color, default "#7b6cf6"
  - `colorD` color, default "#2ec4b6"
  - `speed` float 0–2, default 0.35
  - `warp` float 0–3, default 1
  - `softness` float 0.3–3, default 1
  - `grain` float 0–0.2, default 0.04
- `foil-flakes` Foil flakes (targets overlay/skin; default target overlay; default blend add; animated): Metallic flakes that catch the light one by one as the card tilts, over a fine grain.
  - `amount` float 0–1, default 0.7
  - `flakeSize` float 2–40, default 7 — At the face's texture resolution.
  - `sharpness` float 4–400, default 60 — Higher = fewer flakes lit at once.
  - `spread` float 0–1, default 0.35
  - `twinkle` float 0–2, default 0.4
  - `grain` float 0–0.3, default 0.05
  - `tint` color, default "#fff3d6"
- `halftone` Halftone (targets skin/overlay; default target skin): Print-style dot screen of the artwork (or a gradient), in one ink over the card.
  - `source` int options 0=Artwork (gradient if none), 1=Linear gradient, 2=Radial gradient, default 0
  - `cellSize` float 3–60, default 14 — At the face's texture resolution.
  - `angle` float 0–90, default 45
  - `contrast` float 0.2–3, default 1.2
  - `invert` bool, default false
  - `ink` color, default "#14161a"
- `scanlines` Scanlines (targets overlay/skin; default target overlay; animated): CRT-style scanlines with a slow rolling glow band.
  - `lines` float 20–600, default 180
  - `intensity` float 0–1, default 0.35
  - `glow` float 0–1, default 0.25
  - `speed` float 0–1, default 0.12
  - `lineColor` color, default "#05070a"
  - `glowColor` color, default "#b8ffd9"

## Add-ons

- Shine — `addons.shine: { … }` (`{}` for defaults), animated: Drifting lights, a pastel aura, light streaks and a glint over the card.
  - `tone` select one of "gold" | "ice", default "gold"
  - `intensity` float 0–2, default 1
  - `time` float 0–3600, default 0 — Freeze the light sweep at this time.
- Vines — `addons.vines: { … }` (`{}` for defaults), animated: Ivy that grows over both faces and wraps the edges, sways with the card and casts leaf shadows.
  - `cycle` bool, default true — Loop the 80 s grow / wither cycle; off shows the vines fully grown.
  - `density` float 0.1–1, default 1 — Share of the vines that grow.
  - `leafColor` color, default "#6b9e45" — Recolours the young leaves (autumn colours are kept).
  - `time` float 0–80, default 0 — Freeze the cycle at this time.

Add-on fields:
- `addons.shine` ({ tone?, intensity? } | null): Drifting additive lights and a glint.
- `addons.vines` ({ cycle?, density?, leafColor?, time? } | null): Ivy growing over the card.
